# Code of Conduct

Adapted from the Contributor Covenant, version 2.1. Participation in this
project is expected to be harassment free for everyone. Disagree with a
claim by pointing at a source or a counter-example, never at the person who
raised it.

Report unacceptable behavior via this repository's Security tab (private
advisory) or by contacting the maintainer in `.github/CODEOWNERS` directly.
